label: Sparks
description: Stateful particle effect (docs/RenderEngine.md §5.8): embers thrown up from the bound solid, pulled back by gravity, bouncing off the emitter floor with damping and dimming as they cool. Particle-only — the whole treatment is the emitter, there is no main-stage program. Unlike the stateless companions of the water/fire/fountain packages, the motion is integrated step by step, so the bounce and the spread depend on where each spark has already been. Bind with an Object- or Instance-scope Appearance, or set the Shader's Demo shape.
